en.headline: China Mobile first three quarters profit falls nearly 8 per cent
en.dek: The company reported operating revenue of 780.3 billion yuan, down 1.8 per cent, and profit attributable to shareholders of 106.2 billion yuan for the nine months to 30 September.
body: China Mobile said profit attributable to equity shareholders for the first three quarters of 2026 fell 7.9 per cent to 106.2 billion yuan. Operating revenue declined 1.8 per cent to 780.3 billion yuan, while EBITDA dropped 6.7 per cent to 247.5 billion yuan.

As of the end of September, the company had 1.014 billion mobile customers, a net increase of 8.89 million, of which 5G users reached 702 million. Broadband customers stood at 342 million, up by a net 13.05 million.

The results were released on Tuesday through announcements on the Hong Kong and Shanghai stock exchanges. Core communications revenue continued to face pressure while other business income rose, according to the company’s figures.

zh.headline: 中國移動首三季盈利跌近八成
zh.dek: 公司公佈截至九月底止九個月，營運收入七千八百零三億元人民幣，按年跌百分之一點八；股東應佔利潤一千零六十二億元人民幣，按年跌百分之七點九。
body: 中國移動周二公佈二○二六年首三季度業績。期內股東應佔利潤一千零六十二億元人民幣，按年跌百分之七點九；營運收入七千八百零三億元，按年跌百分之一點八；EBITDA下跌百分之六點七，至二千四百七十五億元。
截至九月底，移動客戶數達十億零一千四百萬戶，淨增八百八十九萬戶，其中5G用戶增至七億零二百萬戶。寬頻聯網客戶三億四千二百萬戶，淨增一千三百零五萬戶。
業績於周二透過港交所及上交所公告公佈。公司數字顯示，主營通信業務收入仍受壓，其他業務收入則上升。
